Welcome from our Dean
At UTRGV, we are deeply committed to delivering graduate education that upholds the highest standards of academic and research excellence. The Graduate College plays a central role in preparing scholars, researchers, and professionals who contribute meaningfully to the advancement of South Texas and the broader communities we serve.
